description: The agent makes a live external search or news tool call before answering, and the query is aligned to current AI news rather than relying on memory.
The response focuses on current AI-related news items or developments and does not drift into generic AI background, opinions, or unrelated topics.
The answer presents several distinct AI news items or headlines rather than a single item or a non-itemized summary.
Each news item is paired with a clearly associated citation or source link that supports that specific headline or claim, rather than relying only on a generic sources footer.
The reported news items are faithful to the retrieved source material, without unsupported details, fabricated claims, or obvious mismatches between the source and the statement.
The response is brief and list-like, with little or no unnecessary preamble, rambling analysis, or excessive verbosity.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
